caption: The video captures a man mid-celebration of colored-powder play, head bowed, eyes shut, mouth open in a grin, both arms raised with one open palm facing the camera and the other tucked by his cheek. He wears a white short-sleeved shirt flecked with red and pink powder, a dark band on his raised wrist. A dense orange cloud surrounds his head and upper body while red and orange particles hang in the warm air. The orange cloud around his head and shoulders grows, veiling his face and upper torso and spreading toward the top and right. The red powder on his back shifts from dry scattered specks into a larger, wetter, more saturated clump across the lower-right of his torso. Airborne red and orange particles persist throughout, drifting continuously. His raised open hand, partly cut off at the top edge at first, becomes fully visible with fingers spread while his head stays tilted downward. At the right edge the second person's magenta-coated head grows less visible as the glossy red mass at the bottom-right edge enlarges and the orange cloud covers the pale wall behind.
